title: [DynISF] Between 23:00 - 00:00 TDD stats only 6 days
body:
I noticed that DynISF stop working between 23:00 and 00:00. Culprit seem to be that for some reason only 6 days of TDD are shown in AAPS Statistics and thus DynISF stop working.

Reproduced in latest dev and master. Can easily be reproduced by manually altering time in android.
Logs from AAPS 3.2 where DynISF was working then stopped working: 
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1698704407889.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13210385/AndroidAPS_LOG_1698704407889.log.zip)


Before 23:00

![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/114103483/659d3fdf-dca6-473b-854b-b0a5a620c4da)

comments.body: wasn't it at DST change day?
